svg.title: Wire format before and after for the three existing MCAP write paths
svg.desc: Current message records and padding are compared with the proposed uncompressed chunk format for per-message write-combine, large-message DMA and slab. Complete message indexes replace trailing padding only when they fit. Chunk indexes are in the file summary. Detailed record fields show byte sizes.
svg.text: Three write paths · wire format before → after
BEFORE: current writer · AFTER: agreed uncompressed-chunk proposal · concrete byte examples
Chunk record: 334 B · ends before Message Index
One chunk record · header appears once across split I/O writes
Chunk record: 2,159 B · finalized before slab sealing
Full Message Index set does not fit · applies to all three paths
Chunk record · no Message Index records follow
Common file framing · all three paths share one file writer
Record fields · sizes in bytes · little endian
